children: The All-India Bank Officers’ Association (AIBOA) has opened a fresh front in its ongoing campaign against proposed strategic sale of IDBI Bank, urging Leaders of Opposition in the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha to intervene in the matter pertaining to ‘contemplated sale of equity in the bank to foreign investors.’

In identical letters to Rahul Gandhi, Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha, and Mallikarjun Kharge, Leader of Opposition in the Rajya Sabha, AIBOA General Secretary S Nagarajan sought their “immediate intervention” by raising the matter on the floor of Parliament.

The officers’ body said it had already approached the President of India, as Custodian of Public Assets; the Union Finance Minister; Governor of Reserve Bank of India; Chairman of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India; and Secretary, Department of Investment and Public Asset Management, seeking that the proposed sale of the banking institution be halted.

title: IDBI Bank sale: Bank officers body writes to Leaders of Opposition, seeks intervention
